# netbox_custom_field_choice_sets (Data Source)

Retrieves all custom field choice sets from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_field_choice_sets" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "custom_field_choice_sets_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_custom_field_choice_sets.example.custom_field_choice_sets[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `custom_field_choice_sets` (Attributes List) The custom field choice sets found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_field_choice_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_field_choice_sets`

Read-Only:

- `base_choices` (String) The base choices of the custom field choice sets.
- `choice_colors` (String) The choice colors of the custom field choice sets.
- `choices_count` (Number) The number of choices objects that refer to the custom field choice sets.
- `created` (String) When the custom field choice sets was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the custom field choice sets.
- `id` (Number) The id of the custom field choice sets.
- `last_updated` (String) When the custom field choice sets was last changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom field choice sets.
- `order_alphabetically` (Boolean) The order alphabetically of the custom field choice sets.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the custom field choice sets.
